name: Finance — LINE slips, ask then auto-save

nodes.name: Ask missing fields or save once

parameters.content:
## LINE → read slip → ask missing fields → automatic save
1. See N8N-LINE-SETUP.md. This workflow is imported inactive.
2. Set the existing Apps Script URL in BOTH Finance HTTP nodes.
3. Select an encrypted HTTP Custom Auth credential: {"body":{"automation_key":"YOUR_RANDOM_SECRET"}}. Never put keys in workflow code.
4. Select an OpenAI API credential. Model defaults to gpt-6-luna; verify availability in your API account.
5. Configure Script Properties and LINE allowlist, test with synthetic slips, then enable the two flags and publish.
6. Keep Raw Body enabled. Only the backend may write financial records. Text-only answers do not call OpenAI.
Execution payload saving is disabled because jobs contain receipt images. No credentials or financial data belong in exported JSON.
